dedupe_keys.name: numina sensor measurement of multimodal activity and shared streets

description: Numina Sensor Measurement of Multimodal Activity and Shared Streets is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mayor's Office of New Urban Mechanics. This dataset is the resulting traffic volume data from a recent pilot of computer-vision sensors. The following metrics were measured: -Volume counts of people, bikes, cars, trucks, and busses passing through pilot project areas -Volumes accounted for by mode and timestamped at up to 15-minute intervals -Desire lines and movement patterns accounted for by mode ... Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Mayor's Office of New Urban Mechanics. Its tags are bike, bike riders, cars, crosswalk, intersection. It offers 14 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2025-02-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
